suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-12 adds this draft-primary relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. The study evaluates treatment-induced hypothyroidism after involved-site radiation therapy for Hodgkin lymphoma and shows that thyroid radiation dose-volume measures predict subsequent hypothyroidism risk. Require documented Hodgkin lymphoma, documented thyroid-exposing neck or supradiaphragmatic radiation treatment consistent with the source phenotype, and separately established hypothyroidism after treatment with compatible chronology. Do not infer hypothyroidism from Hodgkin lymphoma or chemotherapy alone. Preserve autoimmune thyroid disease, thyroid surgery or radioiodine, medications, pituitary or hypothalamic disease, congenital thyroid disease, and other causes of hypothyroidism. The cited literature supports only this constrained proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
